rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: DevOps Toolkit is a collection of 15 MCP servers that expose a complete local DevOps stack running on Kubernetes (Docker Desktop) to AI assistants like Claude. It covers CI/CD (Jenkins, SonarQube), infrastructure (Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD), security (Vault, Trivy), observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki), and storage (MinIO, Nexus, Docker Registry). Together the servers expose 213 tools, with a Streamlit dashboard for visual management.
